items.question: In the UAE, are people with special needs entitled to park in public parking facilities free of charge?
items.gold: Yes, people with special needs are entitled to park free of charge.
items.fact: Special needs people park free in public parking

items.question: Which authorities govern public parking areas in the UAE's emirates?
items.gold: Local transport authorities govern public parking areas in the respective emirates.
items.fact: Local transport authorities govern emirate public parking areas
